_help: Which moves the dancer picks for each moment. Names = file names in moves/ without .fbx. A move can be in several pools. Moves not listed anywhere are sorted in automatically by how energetic they are.
_combos: Body-split mixing: legs/hips from one move + torso/arms/head from another. comboChance = how often (0 = never, 1 = always). badCombos = pairs that look wrong, written as "legs move + arms move".
_segments: Highlights cut out of a move, usable as moves of their own (also in the pools above). Find the times with G in the hologram page.
_noUpper: Moves whose arms/upper body are never used in a combination (they can still play as a whole-body move).
_families: Body-split rules: moves are only mixed within a family or with a compatible family; wholeOnly moves are never split; both halves also need a similar step tempo and energy (checked from the motion).
